name: amaltash
description: Amaltash for Claude: free investment and retirement calculators, and trading for Amaltash account holders.

plugins.name: calculators
plugins.description: Free compound interest, investment, retirement, CD, S&P 500 and DCA calculators in your chat, with charts you can change. No sign-in.

plugins.name: trading
plugins.description: Trade on Amaltash from Claude: connect in one click with OAuth, then create/backtest/fine-tune/deploy strategies, provision a $25K paper account, finish KYC, connect banks via Plaid, deposit from a linked bank, and check balances via the Amaltash MCP server. It can never withdraw money.
